modules.title: School access
modules.purpose: Verified self identity, active enrollment and school policy.

modules.title: My day & classes
modules.purpose: Actionable published schedule and assigned class context.

modules.title: Assignments & submissions
modules.purpose: Private drafts, safe files and explicit versioned submissions.

modules.title: Feedback & progress
modules.purpose: Only returned feedback and published criteria.

modules.title: My attendance
modules.purpose: Read exact recorded sessions and request review.

modules.title: Messages & notices
modules.purpose: Published student notices and staff-scoped conversations.

modules.title: Calendar & events
modules.purpose: Published agenda and eligibility-aware interest responses.

modules.title: Results & reports
modules.purpose: Published, authorized results without private moderation.

modules.title: Requests & support
modules.purpose: Track owned requests without changing official records.

modules.title: School services
modules.purpose: Library, activities and transport are independently enabled.

modules.title: Account & preferences
modules.purpose: Own sessions, verified changes and private-device choices.

modules.title: Learning assistant
modules.purpose: Source-linked explanations within the student purpose.

workflows.title: Find the correct school sign-in
workflows.goal: Enter the school-issued workspace.

steps.title: Use school link
steps.instruction: Check school name and branch; use the school-issued sign-in link.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.instruction: Use the student account assigned by school; no account enumeration or public pupil search.

workflows.invariant: A public school slug is branding, never authorization.
workflows.recovery: Invalid school link offers school contact; invalid credentials remain generic.
workflows.data: Published BrandProfile; UserAccount; verified StudentAccountLink; active Enrollment.

workflows.title: Activate an issued student account
workflows.goal: Accept the exact school-verified account binding.

steps.title: Review invitation
steps.instruction: See intended school and a safe account hint; do not select another child.

steps.title: Activate
steps.instruction: Authenticate intended identity and accept a valid, unrevoked invitation under school policy.

workflows.outcome: Account link active with school-defined capabilities.
workflows.invariant: Mailbox possession does not establish pupil identity; a guardian token cannot activate student authority.
workflows.recovery: Expired, wrong-account or failed-delivery token routes to school help; no self-link.
workflows.data: Access invitation + StudentAccountLink + non-sensitive verification reference.

workflows.title: Recover access
workflows.goal: Regain account access using the permitted policy.

steps.title: Request help
steps.instruction: Submit school identifier and permitted account identifier through a generic response.

steps.title: Complete recovery
steps.instruction: Follow account-wide trust policy; use school/operator assistance if required.

workflows.outcome: Access restored and sessions handled by existing recovery policy.
workflows.invariant: Preserve OPERATOR_CLI/HYBRID/EMAIL and stricter cross-institution recovery checks.
workflows.recovery: No guarantee that an email was sent; delivery failure and operator-assisted routes remain explicit.
workflows.data: Access recovery tokens, organization trust modes, active identity memberships.

workflows.title: Switch enrollment context
workflows.goal: Move safely between own authorized school contexts.

steps.title: Choose context
steps.instruction: List only active verified enrollments with institution, branch and academic year.

steps.title: Resolve current work
steps.instruction: Save/discard a changed draft; unresolved submission must be reconciled first.

workflows.outcome: Destination context and capabilities are reloaded together.
workflows.invariant: Never keep one child identity with another branch; no independent arbitrary branch selector.
workflows.recovery: Revoked or stale destination becomes unavailable; clear protected cached content.
workflows.data: StudentAccountLink + Enrollment + module entitlements + course assignment.

workflows.title: Handle expired or withdrawn access
workflows.goal: Understand why a workspace is unavailable.

steps.title: See safe state
steps.instruction: Clear protected content and explain sign-in or school help is needed.

steps.title: Resume safely
steps.instruction: Reauthenticate and recheck current assignment before recovering work.

workflows.outcome: Authorized continuation or safe support route.
workflows.invariant: Historical access does not authorize current reads, downloads or status lookup.
workflows.recovery: Unknown submissions keep a reference; do not claim a failure or discard evidence.
workflows.data: Session + account status + current account link/enrollment; command receipt.

workflows.title: Plan my school day
workflows.goal: Know the next class and the next deliberate action.

steps.title: Review today
steps.instruction: Show school-local date, next class and a short prioritized list of due work.

steps.title: Open an action
steps.instruction: Go directly to published class details, assignment, returned feedback or notice.

workflows.outcome: Student reaches one clear next task.
workflows.invariant: No engagement score, anxiety countdown, class rank or fabricated completion percentage.
workflows.recovery: Empty timetable and nothing-due states remain useful; display last successful refresh.
workflows.data: Published ScheduleOccurrence + student Assignment projections + returned Feedback.

workflows.title: Read my timetable
workflows.goal: Understand the published week.

steps.title: Select date
steps.instruction: Browse days in school timezone and show current published version.

steps.title: Open class
steps.instruction: Read subject, period, room and permitted teacher name.

workflows.invariant: Manual attendance sessions do not imply a recurring timetable engine.
workflows.recovery: Cancelled, room-changed and not-yet-published are explicit states.
workflows.data: Academic enrollment, offering, published timetable revision and occurrence.

workflows.title: Respond to a changed class
workflows.goal: Notice a schedule change without confusing it with attendance.

steps.title: Read change
steps.instruction: Show old/new room or time with effective date and published notice.

steps.title: View current class
steps.instruction: Navigate to the current occurrence; do not silently open cancelled links.

workflows.outcome: Current class context with visible change.
workflows.invariant: A cancellation never manufactures an attendance outcome.
workflows.recovery: Stale links resolve current published version or a safe cancelled state.
workflows.data: Schedule revision + occurrence + scoped communication update.

workflows.title: Open an assigned class space
workflows.goal: Find course-specific work and resources.

steps.title: Choose my class
steps.instruction: Show only current assigned offerings, grouped by subject.

steps.title: Review class
steps.instruction: Open published work, permitted resources and returned feedback.

workflows.invariant: No class roster, classmates’ marks, guardian contacts or private teacher notes.
workflows.recovery: Ended enrollment follows explicit historical-access policy; default deny new downloads.
workflows.data: Offering + dated Enrollment/AssignmentAudience; minimized student projection.

workflows.title: Find and organize assignments
workflows.goal: Locate work by subject, status and deadline.

steps.title: Choose search attribute
steps.instruction: Default Assignment name; Enter applies search.

steps.title: Refine results
steps.instruction: Fluid multiselect filters and a separate Sort drawer; Cancel does not apply changes.

workflows.outcome: Stable, scoped results with clear status.
workflows.invariant: Draft, Submitted, Returned, Missing and Excused are distinct; due date alone cannot mean failed.
workflows.recovery: No results offers clear filter removal; loading does not erase a changed draft.
workflows.data: Published Assignment + recipient + own draft/attempt summary.

workflows.title: Understand an assignment
workflows.goal: Know what is required before starting.

steps.title: Read requirements
steps.instruction: Show instructions, teacher, subject, due time/timezone, submission modes and published rubric.

steps.title: Choose action
steps.instruction: Start/resume draft or open the exact submitted attempt.

workflows.outcome: Requirements and next action are clear.
workflows.invariant: Policy revision is visible and rechecked on submission.
workflows.recovery: Withdrawn/unpublished assignment blocks new writes and links to school help.
workflows.data: Assignment published version + audience + SubmissionPolicy + criteria.

workflows.title: Open learning resources
workflows.goal: Read authorized material safely.

steps.title: Choose resource
steps.instruction: Show title, type and size before download.

steps.title: Open or download
steps.instruction: Reauthorize resource access; use short-lived scoped links only in implementation.

workflows.invariant: No arbitrary URL fetching; no unscanned/private resource exposure.
workflows.recovery: Expired download retries through authorization, not reuse of a permanent object URL.
workflows.data: Learning resource link + file asset scan state + owner authorization.

workflows.title: Save and resume my draft
workflows.goal: Keep unfinished work without submitting it.

steps.title: Write response
steps.instruction: Type answer and attach supported work; label Unsaved changes.

steps.title: Save draft
steps.instruction: Save against expected draft version; show acknowledged saved time.

workflows.outcome: Private draft saved, still not submitted.
workflows.invariant: Draft belongs to student and assignment; teachers/guardians see no content by default.
workflows.recovery: Conflict offers comparison/reload without silently overwriting either version.
workflows.data: AssignmentDraft keyed student/assignment; optimistic version; attachment references.

workflows.title: Attach and check a file
workflows.goal: Include valid work with clear readiness.

steps.title: Choose file
steps.instruction: Show configured type, size and count limits before selection.

steps.title: Wait for checks
steps.instruction: Show upload/check/ready/blocked separately; retry only failed upload.

workflows.outcome: Clean, student-owned attachment ready for review.
workflows.invariant: Uploading is not submitted; only clean same-draft assets can enter an attempt.
workflows.recovery: Offline, oversized, unsupported, blocked and expired uploads have distinct recovery.
workflows.data: UploadSession, quarantined FileAsset, scan verdict and DraftAttachment.

workflows.title: Review and submit work
workflows.goal: Make one deliberate, confirmed submission.

steps.title: Review work
steps.instruction: Show assignment revision, answer, ready files, effective due date and late status.

steps.title: Submit assignment
steps.instruction: Recheck current rights, assignment policy and draft version; commit one attempt and receipt.

workflows.outcome: Immutable attempt reference, number and accepted time.
workflows.invariant: No implicit submit on upload/save; no mutable file reference that changes an accepted attempt.
workflows.recovery: Validation preserves draft; concurrent policy/draft change requires renewed review.
workflows.data: SubmissionAttempt snapshot + attachment snapshots + command receipt + safe audit.

workflows.title: Recover an uncertain submission
workflows.goal: Find out whether the school accepted the work.

steps.title: See confirmation pending
steps.instruction: Preserve unchanged intent; disable a new submit or context switch.

steps.title: Check status
steps.instruction: Reauthorize and query same command key before retry; exact replay returns the same receipt.

workflows.outcome: Existing accepted receipt or verified safe retry.
workflows.invariant: A timeout is not a failure; never create a second attempt speculatively.
workflows.recovery: Still unknown stays pending with help/reference; no false success.
workflows.data: Scoped CommandReceipt + submission attempt; immutable payload fingerprint.

workflows.title: Submit under late or extended rules
workflows.goal: Understand whether work can still be accepted.

steps.title: Read effective deadline
steps.instruction: Show school-local deadline, explicit extension if granted and late policy.

steps.title: Review allowed action
steps.instruction: Allow late submission only under current policy; otherwise offer extension/support request.

workflows.outcome: Accepted on-time/late attempt or a clear closed state.
workflows.invariant: Server clock and approved per-student extension decide lateness; requesting one never grants it.
workflows.recovery: A deadline crossing during review forces policy re-evaluation, preserving work.
workflows.data: Assignment policy + approved extension + server received_at and effective_due_at.

workflows.title: Revise and resubmit returned work
workflows.goal: Respond to teacher feedback without losing prior evidence.

steps.title: Read returned feedback
steps.instruction: Show exact attempt and whether revisions are allowed.

steps.title: Create revised draft
steps.instruction: Create from an explicit prior attempt; submit a new numbered immutable attempt.

workflows.outcome: New attempt; previous submission and feedback remain traceable.
workflows.invariant: Feedback return does not itself reopen submission; policy/teacher permission must allow it.
workflows.recovery: Closed window or revoked permission blocks new attempt without altering old evidence.
workflows.data: Attempt revision chain + reopened policy + draft + feedback version.

workflows.title: Withdraw a submission when allowed
workflows.goal: Correct an accidental submission through a controlled transition.

steps.title: Review eligibility
steps.instruction: Show withdraw only when policy permits and review has not locked it.

steps.title: Confirm withdrawal
steps.instruction: Recheck expected attempt version; retain evidence and explicitly offer a new draft.

workflows.invariant: Withdrawal does not delete evidence, reset original accepted time or silently reopen a deadline.
workflows.recovery: If teacher review began concurrently, deny withdrawal and offer a teacher query.
workflows.data: Attempt lifecycle/version + teacher review lock + withdrawal event.

workflows.title: Request more time
workflows.goal: Ask for an extension without fabricating approval.

steps.title: Describe request
steps.instruction: Choose assignment, requested deadline and brief reason; avoid compulsory sensitive detail.

steps.title: Submit request
steps.instruction: Show requested, not approved; retain current deadline until an authorized decision.

workflows.outcome: Pending extension request and trackable reference.
workflows.invariant: Student cannot approve own extension; a support request is not an entitlement.
workflows.recovery: Duplicates link existing pending request; unavailable category routes to school help.
workflows.data: Owned request + Assignment reference; authorized extension decision.

workflows.title: Continue safely on a poor connection
workflows.goal: Avoid losing work or duplicating submission.

steps.title: Recognize connection state
steps.instruction: Show unsaved, locally held and server-saved states distinctly.

steps.title: Reconnect and reconcile
steps.instruction: Reauthorize, reconcile draft version and check uncertain command before submitting.

workflows.outcome: Work recovered only after a verified state check.
workflows.invariant: No silent background submission; persistent device draft is opt-in and separately threat-modeled.
workflows.recovery: Shared-device default keeps no sensitive persistent cache; do not promise recovery after tab closure.
workflows.data: Memory editor + optional approved device store; draft version; command status.

workflows.title: Read returned teacher feedback
workflows.goal: Understand feedback tied to my work.

steps.title: Open returned item
steps.instruction: Show attempt number and returned time, student-facing comments and released rubric.

steps.title: Choose next step
steps.instruction: Revise if allowed or ask a permitted clarification.

workflows.outcome: Actionable feedback with appropriate next action.
workflows.invariant: Private notes, draft marks and unreleased comments never enter student DTOs.
workflows.recovery: Feedback withdrawn/revised is reauthorized; show latest published revision and prior release policy.
workflows.data: Returned FeedbackPublication + attempt + student-visible rubric.

workflows.title: Understand criteria and subject progress
workflows.goal: See evidence of learning without misleading averages.

steps.title: Read criteria
steps.instruction: Explain score/outcome, maximum and published assessment scale.

steps.title: Open evidence
steps.instruction: Link to returned tasks and published report items.

workflows.outcome: Transparent evidence, not a synthetic rank.
workflows.invariant: Zero, Not assessed, Absent and Exempt remain different; no denominator inventing.
workflows.recovery: No released evidence gets a useful empty state.
workflows.data: Published criteria + released outcome projections; no private gradebook.

workflows.title: Ask about feedback
workflows.goal: Ask the responsible teacher a focused question.

steps.title: Select feedback
steps.instruction: Carry exact task/attempt reference into a permitted conversation.

steps.title: Send question
steps.instruction: Review recipient and text; only accepted delivery state is reported.

workflows.invariant: No arbitrary staff/peer recipient search or guardian impersonation.
workflows.recovery: If messaging is unavailable, route to a school-owned request.
workflows.data: Conversation grant + feedback reference + message receipt.

workflows.title: View my recorded attendance
workflows.goal: See what the school actually recorded.

steps.title: Select date/session
steps.instruction: Show exact subject/time and Present/Absent/Late/Excused or Awaiting submission.

steps.title: Read details
steps.instruction: Show recorded revision and school-local date.

workflows.invariant: No parent/staff data; unsubmitted attendance is never absence; avoid unsupported daily aggregates.
workflows.recovery: Permission change clears records; corrected outcome has traceable published details.
workflows.data: AttendanceSession + roster member + current authorized mark/revision.

workflows.title: Query an attendance discrepancy
workflows.goal: Ask the school to review an apparent mistake.

steps.title: Choose record
steps.instruction: Reference a submitted session and give a bounded explanation.

steps.title: Submit for review
steps.instruction: Show Pending school review and tracking reference.

workflows.outcome: Owned review request, original record unchanged.
workflows.invariant: Student cannot directly edit attendance or approve absence.
workflows.recovery: Duplicate open query links existing request; final decision remains school-owned.
workflows.data: Student request + exact AttendanceRecord reference; optional authorized correction link.

workflows.title: Read a school notice
workflows.goal: Read updates intended for my enrollment.

steps.title: Open notice
steps.instruction: Show title, sender, audience-safe description and publication time.

steps.title: Read permitted attachments
steps.instruction: Reauthorize attachments; show deadlines/actions explicitly.

workflows.invariant: Read does not mean acknowledged or consented.
workflows.recovery: Retracted notice becomes unavailable with safe context.
workflows.data: Published notice version + audience membership + file asset.

workflows.title: Acknowledge a notice
workflows.goal: Explicitly confirm the exact notice version was read.

steps.title: Review notice
steps.instruction: Show what acknowledgement means.

steps.title: Acknowledge
steps.instruction: Commit one response per student and notice version.

workflows.invariant: Acknowledgement never supplies guardian consent or event permission.
workflows.recovery: Revised notice may need fresh acknowledgement; stale version prompts review.
workflows.data: NoticeAcknowledgement unique recipient/notice_version.

workflows.title: Message a permitted teacher
workflows.goal: Communicate within the school-approved channel.

steps.title: Open conversation
steps.instruction: Use explicit assignment/enrollment-specific participant grant.

steps.title: Compose and send
steps.instruction: Review bounded text and safe attachments; clear pending/sent state.

workflows.invariant: No open peer messaging or access to classmates; block/report route is school-owned.
workflows.recovery: Participant revocation clears thread; unresolved sends are checked before retry.
workflows.data: ConversationGrant + participant + Message + DeliveryAttempt.

workflows.title: Recover a message delivery problem
workflows.goal: Know whether a message was accepted or failed.

steps.title: Inspect status
steps.instruction: Distinguish accepted by school, pending and definitive failure.

steps.title: Recover deliberately
steps.instruction: Check same intent first; resend only after known failure under current grant.

workflows.invariant: Browser success is not staff read confirmation.
workflows.recovery: Show contact/help for persistent failure without exposing provider details.
workflows.data: Message command receipt + delivery attempt safe status.

workflows.title: Review published events and assessments
workflows.goal: Plan around the school schedule.

steps.title: Browse agenda
steps.instruction: Show school-local dates, permitted event details and assessment schedule.

steps.title: Open event
steps.instruction: Read changes, venue, participation requirements and contact.

workflows.invariant: Draft assessment schedules remain hidden; published changes are visible.
workflows.recovery: Cancelled events are labelled and no longer accept interest actions.
workflows.data: CalendarEvent publication + audience + assessment schedule projection.

workflows.title: Express event interest
workflows.goal: Tell school about interest without bypassing consent.

steps.title: Check eligibility
steps.instruction: Show capacity/age/class rules and whether guardian permission is required.

steps.title: Respond
steps.instruction: Record student interest and explicitly show Pending guardian/school approval where required.

workflows.invariant: Student interest is not guardian consent, fee payment or confirmed allocation.
workflows.recovery: Capacity and eligibility are rechecked; waitlist never says confirmed.
workflows.data: EventInterest + eligibility rule; service-owned allocation and separate ConsentRequest.

workflows.title: View my published report
workflows.goal: Read official released results.

steps.title: Choose published report
steps.instruction: List permitted academic year/term versions.

steps.title: Read outcomes
steps.instruction: Show subject, score/outcome, scale and teacher comments released to students.

workflows.invariant: No unreleased marks, moderation, peer ranks or misleading zero for Exempt.
workflows.recovery: Publication withdrawal and access change reauthorize on every open.
workflows.data: AssessmentReport publication + student results + scale version.

workflows.title: Download a published report
workflows.goal: Keep an authorized report copy.

steps.title: Review document
steps.instruction: Show school, term, version and issued date.

steps.title: Download
steps.instruction: Reauthorize at file request; expire download link.

workflows.invariant: A UI link is not file authorization; never export another student.
workflows.recovery: Unavailable/expired document offers recheck, not permanent public URL.
workflows.data: Document render reference + publication version + authorized asset.

workflows.title: Ask about a result
workflows.goal: Request clarification within school policy.

steps.title: Choose outcome
steps.instruction: Carry term, subject and report version.

steps.title: Send query
steps.instruction: Explain issue; route to authorized assessment owner.

workflows.outcome: Query reference with school response state.
workflows.invariant: Student cannot edit a grade or reopen moderation.
workflows.recovery: If formal review window closed, show policy and school-help path.
workflows.data: Owned request + report item version + owner decision.

workflows.title: Create a school support request
workflows.goal: Ask school for non-emergency help.

steps.title: Choose category
steps.instruction: Show only student-allowed categories and expected school response window if configured.

steps.title: Review and send
steps.instruction: State visible recipient team and submit bounded text.

workflows.invariant: No claim of continuous emergency monitoring; show school emergency contact when configured.
workflows.recovery: Unknown submission checks same intent; validation preserves input.
workflows.data: Owned request + category routing + command receipt.

workflows.title: Track or withdraw my request
workflows.goal: Know what happens next.

steps.title: Open own request
steps.instruction: View student-visible status history and requested follow-up.

steps.title: Respond or withdraw
steps.instruction: Reply or withdraw only in permitted state with expected version.

workflows.invariant: Internal staff notes and other requesters remain private.
workflows.recovery: Concurrent resolution blocks outdated withdrawal; reload current version.
workflows.data: Request + public timeline projection + optimistic version.

workflows.title: Request a profile correction
workflows.goal: Correct an official record through school review.

steps.title: Choose allowed field
steps.instruction: Display existing permitted field and proposed correction.

steps.title: Submit change request
steps.instruction: Explain school approval is required; contact verification follows Access policy.

workflows.invariant: No student self-edit of identity, guardian links, enrollment, roles or grants.
workflows.recovery: Duplicate/stale source values require current review.
workflows.data: Student profile projection + proposed change request; owner-only update.

workflows.title: Review my library loans
workflows.goal: Know what is borrowed and when it is due.

steps.title: Open loans
steps.instruction: Show own current loans, due dates and service policy.

steps.title: Open item
steps.instruction: View return instructions and permitted renewal action.

workflows.invariant: No other borrower history; fines if shown are read-only service data, not payer authority.
workflows.recovery: Unreturned/corrected records use library-help path.
workflows.data: LibraryLoan + item catalogue + own borrower mapping.

workflows.title: Request a library renewal
workflows.goal: Ask for more borrowing time.

steps.title: Review rules
steps.instruction: Show eligibility, hold/renewal limits and proposed due date from library.

steps.title: Request renewal
steps.instruction: Recheck current loan/holds; show approved only if owner confirms.

workflows.invariant: Student cannot set loan due date.
workflows.recovery: Concurrent return/hold blocks stale renewal and preserves history.
workflows.data: LibraryLoan version + hold policy + renewal decision.

workflows.title: Join an enabled activity
workflows.goal: Explore eligible activities and request a place.

steps.title: Review activity
steps.instruction: Show schedule, eligibility, places and any required guardian consent.

steps.title: Request place
steps.instruction: Record interest; confirm only after allocation and required approvals.

workflows.invariant: Interest is separate from guardian consent, payment and attendance.
workflows.recovery: Full activity offers waitlist only if enabled; changed schedule requires new review.
workflows.data: ActivityOffer + registration + allocation + Consent reference.

workflows.title: Read my transport assignment
workflows.goal: Know my assigned service and published updates.

steps.title: Open transport
steps.instruction: Show assigned route/stop and school contact.

steps.title: Read update
steps.instruction: Show published delay/cancellation text with time and source.

workflows.invariant: No driver private data, other pupils, live location promise or self-changing pickup authority.
workflows.recovery: Unassigned/unavailable service routes to school; urgent change uses official contact.
workflows.data: TransportAssignment + published service update; no location stream.

workflows.title: Request student wellbeing support
workflows.goal: Ask the authorized school team for support.

steps.title: Understand visibility
steps.instruction: Show who receives the request and school contact for urgent help.

steps.title: Send minimal request
steps.instruction: Allow a brief description without compulsory health details; no confidentiality guarantee.

workflows.invariant: No automated diagnosis, risk score, covert parent disclosure or full health-record access.
workflows.recovery: Unavailable channel clearly routes to school contact; do not imply 24/7 monitoring.
workflows.data: Restricted support request + purpose grants + student-safe timeline.

workflows.title: Manage my sessions
workflows.goal: Protect my school account on shared devices.

steps.title: Review sessions
steps.instruction: Show only own session labels/time; no secrets or raw device identifiers.

steps.title: Revoke or sign out
steps.instruction: Reauthenticate when required; clear local protected state.

workflows.outcome: Selected sessions revoked or current session ended.
workflows.invariant: Keep sign out separate from identity block; server revocation is authoritative.
workflows.recovery: Already-revoked is idempotent; failed revoke must not say completed.
workflows.data: Access session + audit + revocation command.

workflows.title: Set preferences or request contact change
workflows.goal: Adjust communication/accessibility choices safely.

steps.title: Choose preference
steps.instruction: Readable text, notification categories and shared-device preference; required school notices labelled.

steps.title: Save or request change
steps.instruction: Preferences save directly; identity/contact changes require school/access verification.

workflows.outcome: Saved preference or pending verified-change request.
workflows.invariant: No guardian link changes; required security notices cannot be silently disabled.
workflows.recovery: Invalid/failed save keeps prior preferences and announces failure.
workflows.data: Account preference + school policy; verified-change request.

workflows.title: Get help with privacy or accessibility
workflows.goal: Find clear help without collecting unnecessary detail.

steps.title: Choose help
steps.instruction: Offer accessibility issue, account help or privacy enquiry.

steps.title: Send request
steps.instruction: Show school contact/recipient and explicit pending response.

workflows.outcome: Help reference or direct contact route.
workflows.invariant: No invented deletion promise, statutory deadline or automatic disclosure to another account.
workflows.recovery: Failed delivery remains visible; alternative contact shown when configured.
workflows.data: School support configuration + minimum request metadata.

workflows.title: Ask a learning question with sources
workflows.goal: Understand permitted learning material.

steps.title: Ask about a source
steps.instruction: Scope to authorized published resources; show what will be used.

steps.title: Review answer
steps.instruction: Cite sources, state uncertainty and allow feedback; follow teacher/school assessment policy.

workflows.invariant: No autonomous submission, grading, attendance or private learner profiling; untrusted content cannot change permissions.
workflows.recovery: Missing evidence says unavailable; blocked assessment use offers permitted learning help.
workflows.data: Permission-filtered retrieval + redacted evidence + approved model/provider contract.
